title: Prakas On Requirements for Labeling of Household Chemical Products
text:
Unofficial Translation
Kingdom of Cambodia
National Religion King
6
Prakas
on
Requirements for Labelling of Household Chemical Products
Minister of Commerce
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia,
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0918/925 dated 06 September 2018, on the
Appointment of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia,
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0320/421 dated 30 March 2020, on the
Appointment and Adjustment to the Composition of the Royal Government of the
Kingdom of Cambodia,
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0618/012 dated 28 June 2018, promulgating
the Law on the Organization and Functioning of the Council of Ministers,
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/16 dated 24 January 1996, promulgating
the Law on the establishment of the Ministry of Commerce,
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0600/001 dated 21 June 2000, promulgating
the Law on the Management of Quality and Safety of Products and Services,
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/1119/016 dated 02 November 2019,
promulgating the Law on Consumer Protection,
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No.38 ANKR.BK dated 16 March 2020 on Organization and
Functioning of the Ministry of Commerce,
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No.38 ANKR.BK dated 27 August 2020 on the Organization
and Functioning of the National Commission for Consumer Protection,
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No.180 ANKR.BK dated 20 October 2009 on Management
of the Classification and Labelling of Chemicals,
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No.19 ANKR.BK dated 10 February 2021 on the Amendment
of Article 7, 12, 13, 14 of Apendix 2, 3 and 4 of Sub-Decree No.180 ANKR.BK dated 20
October 2009 on Management of the Classification and Labelling of Chemicals,
- Having seen the Prakas No.183 MOC/SM 2006 dated 28 September 2006 on Chemicals
Banned from Food Products,
- Referring to the request of Minister of Commerce.
1

Unofficial Translation
Hereby Decides
Article 1−
This Prakas sets out the requirements for labeling of household chemical products
distributed in the market in the Kingdom of Cambodia for the purpose of protecting the welfare
and interests of consumers.
Article 2−
This Prakas applies to household chemical products distributed in the market in the
Kingdom of Cambodia.
Article 3−
The key terms used in this Prakas shall have the meaning as defined hereunder:
1. Household chemical products refer to chemicals or chemical products that are finished
products which can be harmful to health and are used as additives for the purpose of
other aspects of normal life, such as home use, workshops, gardens or other public
services, that those products are classified in Article 7 of this Prakas.
2. Additional safety information refers to information that describes the hazard level
according to its type and class.
3. Warning message refers to a warning attached with the words "Danger" or "Caution"
on the label of chemical product according to its hazard level.
4. Label refers to the symbol that indicates the type of hazard on the label of the chemical
product to recognize the danger of the chemical product in accordance with the table
in Appendix 2 of the sub-decree No. 19, ANKR.BK dated 10 February 2021.
5. Business refers to activities that:
- Goods or services are supplied or acquired or
- Done in an organized or specific manner or
- The person who performed these activities intended to make a profit regardless if
whether the activity is the main activity, or a secondary or occasional activity.
6. Persons conducting household chemical products business refer to persons who
supply chemical products used in the house, includes wholesale, retail, gift giving or
trial use.
2

Unofficial Translation
7. Recall refers to the performance of activities involving the recall of household chemical
products that are of poor quality, unsafe, or that do not comply with the information
standards distributed or circulated in the market.
8. E-commerce refers to the activities of buying, selling, leasing, exchanging goods or
services, including commercial and civil activities, as well as governmental electronic
activities and transaction.
9. Chemical Solvents refer to substances that have the ability to dissolve other substances
or compounds into solid mixtures, including Toluene, Acetone, Ethyl Acetate, Ethanol
and Methanol, Isopropyl Alcohol and other substances.
10. Distribution refers to the supply of products in the market, including wholesale, retail,
giving of gifts or trial use.
Article 4−
Persons conducting household chemical products business are responsible for ensuring
that their products are of good quality and safe and have proper labeling in accordance with
applicable laws and regulations.
All household chemical products distributed in the market in the Kingdom of Cambodia
shall have a permit to import, manufacture and distribute from the relevant ministries or institutions.
Article 5−
All household chemical products shall be displayed in a safe place and separated from food
products.
Article 6−
All labeling of household chemical products shall not be misrepresented or mislead,
deceive or cheat consumers.
All household chemical products distributed in the market in the Kingdom of Cambodia
shall have a minimum standard of information in Khmer that can be attached with the package or
the description of the product. The minimum information standard requirements include:
- Name, address and contact number of the manufacturer, importer, distributor or
responsible person
- Product name including common name, trade name or chemical name
- Production date, expiration date and code or batch / lot number
3

Unofficial Translation
- Active ingredient (in French or English)
- Function, use, how to use and storage
- Warning messages for children
- Signal word such as Risk or Danger
- Hazard statement
- Precautionary statement
- Supplementary information
- Pictograms and graphic symbols as in Appendix 2 of Sub-Decree No. 19 ANKR.BK
- Emergency instructions.
In case the size, shape or characteristic of the package or label may not be large enough to
describe the content as defined in accordance with the requirements of the above information
standards, the persons conducting household chemical products business may use the description
card, information disclosure label, wrapping material or other means.
Household chemical products distributed in the market in the Kingdom of Cambodia may
be allowed to use product names in English or French and be translated into Khmer, such as
Common Name, Trade Name or Chemical Name.
Article 7−
All household chemicals are grouped according to the following purpose:
a. Detergents include:
- Laundry detergents
- Common cleaning agents
- Bleaching agents
- Dishwashing detergents
- Oven cleaners
- Antibacterial cleaners
- Window and glass cleaner
- Toilet bowl cleaners
- Mold and mildew removers
- Drain cleaners
- Swimming pool chloride tablets
- Algicides for the pool
4

Unofficial Translation
- Rug, carpet, upholstery cleaners
- Furniture polish
- Air fresheners.
b. Pesticides used in the house include:
- Rodenticides or bait
- Pesticides for bedbugs
- Insecticides for houseplants
- Pesticides and soaps for pet lice
- Pesticides for cockroaches, ants or termites.
c. Substances used for home garden protection include:
- Insecticides
- Herbicides
- Fungicides
- Wood preservative
- Adhesive and Glues
- Furniture strippers
- Oil-or enamel-based paint
- Stains and finishes
- Chemical solvent
- Desiccant.
d. Other chemicals that are not allowed to be used in food include:
- Borax or Sodium Borate or Boric Acid
- Salicylic Acid
- Formaldehyde, Para Formaldehyde
- Synthetic Dyes such as Para Red, Rhodamine B, Sudan Red, Malachite Green
- Melamine.
Article 8−
Persons conducting household chemical products business electronically shall apply for an
additional permit from the relevant ministries and institutions as follows:
5

Unofficial Translation
- Natural persons shall apply for an electronic business license from the Ministry of
Commerce and an online service certificate from Ministry of Posts and
Telecommunications.
- Legal persons shall apply for a license to operate electronic services from the Ministry
of Commerce and an online service certificate from the Ministry of Posts and
Telecommunications.
Article 9−
It is prohibited to transfer household chemical products (origin) from one packaging box
to another or from one container to another for the purpose of distribution without permission from
the relevant competent ministries and institutions. New products obtained from the transfer shall
be properly labeled in accordance with the information standards set out in Article 6 of this Prakas.
Article 10−
Persons conducting household chemical products business shall have relevant documents
from the source that supplied the product and shall provide those documents as required by the
competent official to facilitate the investigation and recall of chemical products used in the house
that are found or received information that is unsafe to consumers or does not comply with
technical regulations.
Article 11−
Persons conducting household chemical products business that do not comply with the
requirements for labelling and conditions set forth in this Prakas shall be subject to penalties as
provided in the Law on Consumer Protection and other relevant regulations in force.
Article 12−
This Prakas shall be implemented immediately after signing, except for all household
chemical products that have been distributed in the market, leaving three (3) months for the
business to make adjustments.
Article 13−
The Composition of the National Committee for Consumer Protection, Director of the
Cabinet, Delegate of the Royal Government of Cambodia in charge as the Director General of the
Consumer Protection Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate-General “CCF”, the Heads
6

Unofficial Translation
of all units under the Ministry of Commerce, household chemical products business operators and
related units shall implement this Prakas from the date of its signing.
Friday, the 7th day of the waxing moon of the tenth month,
In the year of the Tiger, Chatvasak, B.C. 2566
Phnom Penh, 2 September 2022
Minister of Commerce
Seal and Signature
PAN SORASAK
Recipients:
-The Office of the Council of Ministers
-The Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology and Innovation
-The Ministry of Health
-The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries
- Cabinet of Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Prime Minister
